verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for remote-access software, since self-hosted relay or server alternatives exist in this category, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a self-hosted or on-premise TeamViewer deployment. MSI mass deployment covers client installs, not hosting the core service, and one user leaving for a self-hosted alternative implies TeamViewer is not one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
